fact: The document is the text of Liberia's National Statistics and Geo-Information Act, an Act adding Chapter 50A to the New Executive Law, which establishes LISGIS as an autonomous agency; it is marked approved 22 July 2004.

The LISGIS microdata catalogue entry for the Liberia Annual Agricultural Survey 2024 says respondent confidentiality is guaranteed by the National Statistics and Geo-Information Act of Liberia, enacted in 2004.

The LISGIS microdata catalogue entry for the Women's Empowerment and Nutrition Survey 2024 says respondent confidentiality is guaranteed by the National Statistics and Geo-Information Act of Liberia, enacted in 2004.
